svg.aria-label: Animated bars: the 60 least-served ICLR 2018 papers with 1,000 reviewers taking at most 3 papers. Under the highest-total assignment the worst-off paper gets 0.071; under the fair assignment 0.099, 39% more, for 0.10% less total expertise.
svg.title: Fair assignment when reviewers are scarce
svg.text: When reviewers are scarce, protect the paper that gets the least
ICLR 2018 (911 papers) with 1,000 reviewers taking at most 3 papers each. Expertise of the 60 least-served papers, sorted.

g.text: Highest total expertise: the worst-off paper gets 0.071
Fair: worst-off paper 0.099 (+39%), total expertise only 0.10% lower

svg.text: Both proven optimal for their goal. When reviewers are plentiful the two coincide: fairness only matters when expertise is scarce.
